resources.string: Haven uses Accessibility to detect blocked apps and blocked website addresses in your browser, then shows a blocking screen. Haven does not use a VPN, does not read passwords, and does not upload browsing history.
Enable Device Admin so uninstalling Haven requires an extra confirmation step while protection is on. You can disable this anytime in system settings.
App info for Haven is locked so it cannot be uninstalled from here.\n\nGo Back, or enter the password to open App info for 5 minutes.
